name: COFCO Biotechnology Co., Ltd.
summary: COFCO Biotechnology Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the processing of agricultural products in China. The company offers ethanol disinfectants, pharmaceutical ethanol, edible alcohol, anhydrous ethanol, and denatured fuel ethanol; edible corn starch; and flavoring, glucose, malt, and high fructose syrup. It also provides food additives and others, such as corn crude oil, phytosterol red yeast rice tea polyphenol tablets, natural vitamin E soft capsules, phytosterols, and vitamin E; corn germ meal, sprayed corn husks, corn protein powder, and corn dried alcohol distillers; and polylactic acid products. The company was formerly known as COFCO Biochemical (Anhui) Co., Ltd.…
